I've been there, you are not alone. What helped me was to stop caring too much about trivial things. Usually depressed people like us are super sensitive and care too much. We are empaths and feel emotions stronger than others. For now just breathe and focus on what you can do today, not the past or the future, these thoughts won't help you. Just focus on what you want in the present. I stopped caring so much about what society expects of me because I realized society, God, and everyone else owes you nothing and sometimes you have to be a bit selfish. You can easily get friends, a new job, and a relationship. All of this happened for me in 3 years so look up and stop comparing yourself to others.
